hook: Your map shows a rust-red river in Spain.
title: Your Map Shows a River as Red as Rust
description:
Spain's Rio Tinto runs rust-red because of dissolved iron and acidic water linked to old mines. The colours are so unusual that the area is studied as a Mars-like place. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you swim here? Yes or no
